scope: Actual engine, read-only vector renderer, native Canvas and controlled DOM. Not original Capcom animation/geometry certification.

checks.name: Only four reviewed production profiles change; 111 remaining definitions are exact
Nemesis rocket equipment does not gain fire, another mutation, or teleportation
Nemesis backward jump moves continuously and lands without a position jump
Rocket hits once, explodes once and cannot also apply direct contact damage
A missed rocket detonates once on the wall without damaging a remote opponent
Rocket explosion preserves frontal guard and gives no spatial critical bonus
Gatling sustained emissions stop after a real interrupt; emitted rounds survive
Uninterrupted Gatling burst emits six rounds at authored intervals, charged only once
Pending burst originates at current actor position while keeping engaged facing
Jill burst respects the same interruption rules without a new biological effect
Nemesis super costs gauge and resource once and exposes a punishable startup
Full Nemesis salvo has exactly three independently colliding explosive rounds
Quadruped super has two active windows separated by a real non-hitting gap
Interrupting the quadruped sequence removes its second strike without refund
Pounce collision remains closed during ascent and opens on the descent window
Shared effects read simulation state without modifying resources, RNG or event logs
Rocket, ballistic, flame, secretion and electric visuals use distinct pixel geometry
Window cues have no attack stroke during startup or between active hits
Four authored scenes produce distinct deterministic images and changing animation frames
Interior precipitation is disabled while exterior rain remains allowed
All combat/laboratory screens load the identical shared effects implementation
Primary and annex benches execute new real startup/gap mechanics with no save packets
Stage workshop filters safely and returns from lifecycle events as one paused loop
All declared multi-hit windows are bounded and profiles have unique ten-slot names
